thread:
elena: Quick post-all-hands follow-up for security/compliance items (SOC2/ISO, VPC/control plane, audit logs, KMS/BYOK). Drop short questions and we'll assign owners.

aya: SOC2 status: Type I done. Type II audit window planned for May-July, report expected Q3. ISO 27001 scoped for next year. I'll publish exact dates once auditor confirms.

ryan: Can customers host the control plane in their VPC or only the data plane?

aya: Data plane runs in customer VPC for Private deployments. Control plane is normally Redwood-managed but we support PrivateLink and peering; for fully air-gapped/on-prem installs we provide a packaged control-plane option customers can host. We'll add a topology diagram to infra docs.

chris: KMS question: which providers and any HSM support?

aya: We support AWS KMS and GCP KMS today; Azure Key Vault on roadmap. Envelope encryption ensures Redwood never sees plaintext CMKs. CloudHSM/PKCS#11 is in a pilot for an enterprise customer; GA depends on demand and audit needs.

sam: Audit logs: formats, retention, and export options? PII redaction?

eli: Exports available as ndjson (JSON Lines) and gzipped bundles. Default retention 90 days; enterprise add-on up to 7 years. We can stream/export to customer S3, Kafka, or webhooks to SIEMs. Server-side configurable redaction/field masking happens before export.

elena: Action items: @aya publish SOC2/ISO timeline + scope matrix; eng-infra add VPC/control-plane topology and Private install checklist; security publish KMS/BYOK guide and BYOK onboarding flow; ops document audit-log export/retention flows. Reply here if you want to join pilots or doc reviews.
__notes: compact follow-up thread summarizing all-hands security Q&A; matches agents.md requirements
